findings.label: Inline styling pattern
findings.description: All components use React inline styles instead of the superadmin.css file that exists in the codebase. This creates brittleness: design tweaks require multiple component edits, and the CSS file becomes dead code. Consider migrating to class-based styling or clarifying that inline styles are the preferred pattern.

findings.label: Incomplete confirmation dialog in Invitations
findings.description: The Invitations page implements its own confirmDialog state instead of using the project's ConfirmProvider hook (which other pages use). This creates dual confirmation UX patterns: manual state for revoke, and hook-based for nothing else. Standardize on the ConfirmProvider pattern.

findings.label: Auto-copy token without user interaction
findings.description: The Invitations page auto-copies the invitation token after creation with a setTimeout. This is convenient but non-standard UX: clipboard operations should be explicit user actions. The 100ms delay is also fragile if page rendering slows. Consider using navigator.clipboard.writeText() instead of deprecated document.execCommand().

findings.label: View Details button is a stub
findings.description: The Teachers page has a 'View Details' button that only logs to console. Either implement the detail view or remove the button to avoid false affordance.

findings.label: Filter relationship ambiguity in Invitations
findings.description: The relationship between status filtering (pending, used, revoked, expired) and the 'Include Expired' checkbox is unclear. If both are applied simultaneously, the intended behavior should be documented or the UI should clarify the interaction.
